name: Percy Outrage
visual: Male-read broad box-rounded goo body, two short crest nubs, tiny faded ochre pajama collar. One hand pressed to chest in offended disbelief, other palm sharply up near shoulder. One eye enormous and other narrowing, eyebrows uneven not matching V, wide CLOSED buckled pout with no outside teeth. Outrage at a petty inconvenience, not armed soldier anger.
personality: He regards this inconvenience as a serious misunderstanding of his importance.
biography: Percy considers the HyperNorm timetable a private understanding between himself and reality. The Men in Black appreciate his complaints; Hunky and Dory help enlarge them. A contradictory card asked whether the delay had inconvenienced anyone else. He began a forceful reply and noticed the resident beside him carrying a heavier bag. Percy remains offended. He has, however, offered to carry it while explaining why.
note: FrizzleBob: The inconvenience is minor. His involvement has corrected that.

name: Bert Wontbudge
visual: Male-read stout asymmetric diamond-lobed ink blob with swept sidecrest, bare body. BOTH short ink arms folded tightly across his goo belly, chin lifted, weight leans forward but upright. Determined clear white eyes, one brow down and other arrogantly up, tiny CLOSED tilted smirk. Stubborn refusal visible in the whole silhouette, no fists holding weapons.
personality: He has made up his mind and is using the rest of his body to keep it there.
biography: Bert refuses to move on the HyperNorm landing until someone explains why he should. The Men in Black admire firmness when it faces the right direction; Hunky and Dory provide directions. A dissonant card suggested that changing position need not mean losing. He is testing this cautiously. Yesterday he moved aside for a tired neighbour and described it as a strategic improvement.
note: FrizzleBob: His position is firm. Its usefulness is being negotiated.
calls: That does not make you right.
voice: English low compact baritone, stubborn controlled emphasis

name: Tess Anyminute
visual: Female-read tall thin undulating ink blob with two soft hanging crest loops, modest lashes and small muted green headband. One ink hand presents a tiny brass wristwatch strapped to OTHER short ink wrist, no numbers on dial. Heavy white-eye lids, irises sidelong, brow crooked in pointed annoyance, CLOSED long flat pursed mouth. Upright twist of impatience, no foot tapping or human limbs.
personality: She has allowed enough time for everyone else to stop taking it.
biography: Tess checks her watch whenever HyperNorm promises something shortly. The Men in Black consider waiting orderly; Hunky and Dory consider it somebody else's time. A contradictory card asked whether urgency and importance were the same thing. She disliked the delay in answering. She now lets a slow neighbour finish speaking, although her eyebrows continue to file objections.
note: FrizzleBob: Any minute now has exceeded its original duration.
calls: I was ready some time ago.
voice: English clipped contralto, precise pauses with visible restraint

name: Arthur FineThen
props: one small empty cloth shopping bag
visual: Male-read wide drooping pear blob with low wilted central crest. Holds ONE empty little cloth shopping bag loosely at side, other ink palm turned up in a tiny exhausted shrug. White eyes half-open looking down toward camera, brows folded into lopsided weary arches, mouth CLOSED diagonal sigh-line. Whole body softens but remains upright at full cell size, not melted puddle or lying down.
personality: He has accepted the situation without endorsing its handling.
biography: Arthur went shopping after HyperNorm announced that normal service had resumed. The empty bag suggests that normal service may be an attitude. The Men in Black ask him to remain positive; Hunky and Dory offer another announcement. A dissonant card permits him to be tired without declaring everything hopeless. He takes the long route home and checks whether anyone else needs something carried.
note: FrizzleBob: He accepts the outcome. Approval was not included.
calls: That will be how it is, apparently.
voice: English dry low tenor, a sigh without theatrical despair

name: Winnie Lastwink
props: tiny blue sleep-mask lifted above eyes
visual: Female-read broad round blob with one small floppy crest, modest lashes, tiny faded blue sleep-mask pushed ABOVE brows and fully clear of eyes. One ink hand supports cheek while other hangs naturally close against body. One heavy lid barely open but white sclera/red iris/black pupil visible, other eye open a little more, OPEN sideways yawn with two upper teeth and no tongue gag. Upright, not asleep sitting/lying, no pillow or bed.
personality: She has enough energy to object once the next yawn has finished.
biography: Winnie keeps her sleep-mask above her eyes because HyperNorm disturbances rarely respect bedtime. The Men in Black value alert residents; Hunky and Dory keep improving the alert. A contradictory card asked if rest might be part of responsibility. She read it twice to stay awake, then left a quiet-hours note for the neighbour who works nights. Nobody has classified the kindness yet.
note: FrizzleBob: She is still awake. This should not be mistaken for availability.
calls: Can that wait until I exist properly?
voice: English husky alto, slow words and a restrained yawn

name: Felix Notmyproblem
visual: Male-read compact scalloped round goo body with an offset curled crest. One hand grips a single small plain bread roll near belly, other lightly pinches his OWN mouth corner trying to suppress a snicker. Sideways white eyes sparkle, one brow raised in amused judgement, OPEN narrow tilted grin reveals two irregular upper teeth. Everyday petty delight rather than villain cackle; not same smile as other cells, no cup or pirate gear.
personality: He is pleased it happened to someone else and mildly ashamed of the efficiency.
biography: Felix takes his bread roll to the HyperNorm landing where small mishaps are discussed with unnecessary interest. The Men in Black encourage useful reports; Hunky and Dory ask for better details. A dissonant card made him recognise the same foolishness in his own complaint. He nearly laughed. Later he helped the neighbour recover a parcel and told nobody how entertaining the earlier part had been.
note: FrizzleBob: His concern is genuine. It has arrived after the amusement.
calls: Oh dear. Was that the new one?
I am trying to be appropriately sorry.
voice: English sly light baritone, a chuckle held just short of speech
